主要内容: Brookfield Asset Management Inc. (TSX: BAM.A) (Euronext: BAMA) closed the sale of Longview Timber and Longview Fibre Paper and Packaging for aggregate proceeds of $3.675 billion. Longview Timber was sold to Weyerhaeuser Co. for $2.65 billion, yielding net cash proceeds of approximately $600 million. Longview Fibre Paper and Packaging was sold to KapStone Paper and Packaging for $1.025 billion, yielding net cash proceeds of approximately $250 million. The closing of these two transactions increased Brookfield’s liquidity by approximately $850 million and resulted in an attractive risk-adjusted return on capital to Brookfield, its flagship public infrastructure entity and investors in Brookfield’s private funds.
